verses.text: Ayik wan snhusantz'a incienso winhaj Jeroboam t'a yib'anh altar t'a chonhab' Betel, ix k'och jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winh ix kot t'a Judá.

Ha wal Jehová ix chekan winh, yuj chi' te ow ix yutej winh yalan t'a altar chi', ix yalan winh: Ha hex tzeyak'em he b'a t'a jun altar tik, ha wal Jehová ix halani to ha t'a yinhtilal winhaj David ay jun unin ol aljok. Ha jun chi', Josías ol sb'i'ej. Ha winh ol milancham juntzanh heb' winh sacerdote yik komon Dios t'a yib'anh jun altar tik, haton heb' snhusan incienso t'a tik. Ol snhusanpaxtz'a sb'akil anima winh t'a yib'anh, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' chi'.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi' tas ol ujok yik sch'oxaneli to schekab' Jehová yaj winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha jun altar tik ol pojb'atok, haxo k'e'en ta'anh ayek' t'a yib'anh tik, ol tob'kanb'at k'e'en, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Ayek' winhaj rey Jeroboam t'a stz'ey altar chi', ayik ix yab'an winh masanil tas ix yal winh schekab' Dios yuj jun altar chi', ix yak'anb'at jekan sk'ab' winh sch'oxan winh schekab' Dios chi', ix yalan winh: Yamec jun winh tik, xchi winh. Palta ha sk'ab' winh ix b'at jekan chi', ix tzatzb'ikanel li'an, majxo yal-laj spakan sb'a.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix pojb'at jun altar chi', haxo jantak k'e'en ta'anh ay t'a yib'anh, ix tob'kanb'at k'e'en. Ix elk'och icha ix schek Jehová yal winh schekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh schekab' Dios chi': Swal t'ayach to tzach tewi t'a Jehová ha Diosal wu'uj, yik sb'oxikan hin k'ab' tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winh chekab' chi' t'a Jehová, ix b'oxikan sk'ab' winh rey chi' ichataxon yaji.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh schekab' Dios chi': --Konh wet' t'a hin pat, ol hach wa jab'ok yakb'an tzin b'o jab'ok tas ol hin si'ej t'ayach, xchi winh.
Palta ix tak'wi winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Wach'chom nanhal tas ay t'ayach tzak' t'ayin, manh ol hin b'atlaj het'ok, max yalpax hin wa'i, ma wuk'an ha ha' t'a jun lugar tik.
Yujto ha Jehová ix halan t'ayin icha tik: Malaj jab'ok tas ol ha wa'a, manh ol uk'ejpax jab'ok ha ha', manh ol hach meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ol hach b'atok, xchi t'ayin, xchi winh chekab' chi'.
Ch'okxo jun b'e b'aj ix meltzaj winh schekab' Dios chi', manhxo'oklaj t'a jun b'e b'aj ix k'och winh t'a Betel chi'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ay jun winh schekab' Dios te icham winakxo kajan t'a Betel chi'. Ha heb' yuninal winh ix halan t'ay tas ix sk'ulej winh schekab' Dios t'a Betel t'a jun k'u chi', haton winh ix kot t'a Judá. Ix yalanpax heb' t'a winh smam chi' tas ix yal winh chekab' chi' t'a winh rey chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh icham chi' t'a heb' yuninal chi' icha tik: --¿Tas b'e'al b'aj ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi'? xchi winh. Ix yalan heb' winh b'aja b'e b'aj ix b'at winh chi'.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh yuninal chi': --Hak'ekoch stz'um nok' hin b'uru, xchi winh. Ixlajwi yoch stz'um nok' yuj heb', ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh nok',

ix b'at tzak'an winh t'a spatik winh schekab' Dios aj Judá chi'. Ix k'och winh t'a spatik winh ayik k'ojanem winh t'a yich jun te' mach', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh: --¿Tom ha hach tik schekab' hach Dios hach kot t'a Judá? xchi winh. --Ha hin toni, xchi.
--Konh wet' wa'el t'a hin pat, xchi winh icham winak chi'.
Ix tak'wi winh schekab' Dios chi': Max yal-laj hin b'ati yik tzin wa het'ok, ma wuk'an ha' et' t'a jun lugar tik.
Yujto icha tik ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayin: Malaj jab'ok tas ol ha wa'a, manh ol uk'ejpax jab'ok ha ha', manh ol hach meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ol hach b'atok, xchi t'ayin, xchi winh.

Palta ix yalanxi winh icham winak chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha hin tik schekab' hin pax Dios icha hach tik. Ha jun yángel Jehová ix halan t'ayin to tzach wik'b'at wa'el t'a hin pat, swak'anpax ha' uk'ej, xchi winh. Palta tonhej ix yesej winh icham winak chi' t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' winh icham winak chi' t'a spat, ix wa winh, ix yuk'an ha' winh.
Wanto swa heb' winh, ix lolon Jehová t'a winh schekab' icham winakxo chi', ix yalani:
--Ix ha pitej ha b'a, maj ha k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová t'ayach,

yujto ix hach meltzaji, ix hach wa'i, ix uk'anpax ha' t'a jun lugar b'aj ix yal Jehová to max yal-laj. Yuj chi' jun, manh ol mukchaj ha niwanil b'aj mukan heb' ha mam icham, xchi winh icham winak chi' t'a winh.
Ayik ix lajwi swa'i yet' yuk'an ha' winh schekab' Dios ix kot t'a Judá chi', ix yak'anoch stz'u'um jun nok' sb'uru winh icham winak chi', ix yak'an nok' winh t'a winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ix pax winh schekab' Dios chi', palta haxo t'a yol b'e ix elta jun nok' choj t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj nok'. Hata' ix kan telan sniwanil winh, haxo nok' b'uru yet' nok' choj chi', ayek' nok' t'a stz'ey sniwanil winh chi'.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh winak ix ek' ta', ix yilan heb' winh to telanek' sniwanil jun chamnak t'a yol b'e chi', haxo nok' choj chi' ayek' nok' t'a stz'ey. Ix b'at heb' winh b'aj kajan winh icham winak schekab' Dios chi', ix yalan heb' winh tas ix yil heb' winh t'a yol b'e chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winh icham winak chi', winh ix b'at ik'an meltzaj winh schekab' Dios t'a yol b'e chi', ix yalan winh: Haton winh schekab' Dios maj k'anab'ajan tas ix yal Dios chi', yuj chi' ix ak'ji'och winh t'a yol sk'ab' nok' choj chi', ix tzilchitajb'at winh yuj nok', icha ix aj yalan Jehová, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' yuninal to syak'och stz'u'um junok nok' b'uru heb'. Ix yak'anoch stz'u'um nok' heb'.

Ix b'at winh icham winak chi', ix k'och winh b'aj telan ek' sniwanil winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a yol b'e chi'. Ha nok' b'uru yet' nok' choj chi', ayek' nok' t'a stz'ey sniwanil winh chi'. Mantalaj jab'ok sniwanil winh schi nok' choj chi', malaj pax ix utaj nok' b'uru chi' yuj nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ank'e wa'an sniwanil winh schekab' Dios aj Judá winh icham winak chi'. Ix yak'ank'e winh t'a yib'anh nok' sb'uru chi', ix yik'anb'at winh t'a schonhab' chi', yik tz'och winh t'a kusk'olal yuj, yik smukanpax winh.
Ha b'aj ijan ix mukji winh icham chi', hata' ix yak'och sniwanil winh schekab' Dios chi' winh. Ix te kus winh yet' heb' winh yuninal, ix yalan heb': Ay, hach kuktak, ob'iltak hach, xchi heb' winh.

Ayik toxo ix lajwi yak'ankanoch sniwanil winh chi' winh icham chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' yuninal chi': --Ayik ol hin chamok, ol heyak'och hin niwanil b'aj ix ochkan sniwanil winh schekab' Dios tik, junnhej tzeyutejkanoch hin niwanil tik yet'ok.
Yujto yowalil ol elk'och tas ix schek Jehová yal winh t'a jun altar t'a Betel tik yet' t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh ay t'a yol yik Samaria tik, haton b'aj syak'em sb'a heb' anima, xchi winh.

Wach'chom ix uji juntzanh chi', palta ha winhaj rey Jeroboam chi', maj yaktejkan masanil schuk b'eyb'al winh, ix yak'nhejoch heb' komon anima winh sacerdote'al t'a juntzanh komon Dios t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh. Yalnhej mach snib'ej winh tz'och sacerdote'al, syak'nhejoch yopisio heb' winh t'a juntzanh lugar chi'.
Ichaton chi' ix aj yochnhej smul winhaj Jeroboam yet' heb' yinhtilal, yuj chi' ix satel heb' smasanil.
